## KoattyContext.principal property

MCP protocol adaptation (roadmap Phase F, item F-1).

Populated by `koatty_mcp` for every tool / resource / prompt call: the caller identity, the session id, the cancellation signal and a progress reporter live on the EXISTING request context instead of a parallel ToolContext store. All fields are optional, so non-MCP requests are unaffected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
principal?: KoattyPrincipal;
```
